mapper.select: SELECT RECORD_ID as recordId, SESSION_ID as sessionId, NAME as name, EMAIL as email, IP_ADDRESS as ipAddress, JOIN_TIME as joinTime, LEAVE_TIME as leaveTime FROM ATTENDANCE_RECORD WHERE RECORD_ID = #{recordId}

SELECT record_id as recordId, session_id as sessionId, name, email, COALESCE(ip_address, '') as ipAddress, DATE_FORMAT(join_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as joinTime, CASE WHEN leave_time IS NOT NULL THEN DATE_FORMAT(leave_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') ELSE '진행중' END as leaveTime, CASE WHEN leave_time IS NOT NULL THEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, join_time, leave_time) ELSE '-' END as participationMinutes, CASE WHEN leave_time IS NULL THEN '참여중' ELSE '퇴장완료' END as status FROM ATTENDANCE_RECORD
AND session_id = #{scSessionId}
AND name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{scName}, '%')
AND email LIKE CONCAT('%', #{scEmail}, '%')
AND DATE(join_time) = #{scJoinTime}
ORDER BY join_time
ASC
DESC

SELECT COUNT(*) as totalCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN leave_time IS NULL THEN 1 END) as activeCount FROM ATTENDANCE_RECORD WHERE 1=1
AND session_id = #{scSessionId}
